steps.text: I'm looking at the Atomic Red Team test for malicious logon script persistence, examining how the parent process relates to the registry value used to establish it.

arguments.reasoning: Identify the parent process that launched reg.exe.
Get the registry value entity set by reg.exe.
Inspect parent process (likely cmd/powershell) and its other activity.
Check which file cmd.exe wrote (likely art.bat payload).
Confirm written file is the art.bat logon script payload.

submission.reasoning: This is logon script persistence (T1037.001) on workstation5, and it matches an Atomic Red Team 'art.bat' test. First, an interactive cmd.exe (proc-23dc9b1636) running as WORKSTATION5\wardog wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat at 02:46:45. Then at 02:47:08 it launched reg.exe (proc-55d9f85e37) at High integrity. reg.exe set HKCU\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript to point at that batch file, so the script will run each time wardog logs on.
